ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution consisting of approximately 80% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels and 20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels from localized markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High density of small, light-intensity circular blobs (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; a single larger contiguous white patch is located at the distal-lateral tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central convergence of the lobes, partially obscured at the base by splashing water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a more jagged, irregular topography than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curves leading from the medial convergence toward the distal fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed uniformly across the visible ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of fine, diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial region of the left lobe lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Global coverage of circular barnacle scarring (rosettes); the right fluke tip displays a ragged, irregular geometric loss of tissue compared to the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density and high contrast of ring-shaped circular scars across 90% of the visible surface area.
